sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-220 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, but only with SUP-B. There is no entry for SUP-C. The 2026-11-06 re-audit restored company standing only and gave no part approval, so 'Quality approved Chisone' does not release BR-220.

sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. A change of source needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP) before shipment and 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers it, and DEV-127 was rejected.

sources.quote:
cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-220 is made from EN AW-6082-T6, so the issue applies to this part.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
Not interchangeable with EN AW-6082-T6 is required

findings.why: The drawing requires MAT-6082-T6 (yield of at least 250 MPa, SC-BR220-YS). SUP-C is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5, which has a typical yield of 230 MPa. The claim that it is 'the same alloy as BR-310' ignores the temper, and BR-310 uses T5.

sources.quote:
A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: SUP-C has 3.1 certificates only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. There is none for MAT-6082-T6, the drawing material of BR-220. Owner: the supplier quality engineer (PER-GALLO).
